snippet.title: Arctic Awakening - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Arctic Awakening, coming to Steam, Xbox Series X|S and PS5 on September 18: https://arcticawakening.com

Arctic Awakening is a first-person narrative adventure set in the unforgiving Arctic. Your plane crashed in a storm, leaving only your court-mandated therapy bot for company as you journey to find your co-pilot and uncover the mysteries buried beneath the ice.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275550/Arctic_Awakening/?utm_source=youtube
Wishlist on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/arctic-awakening/9N87DRF76K0B
Wishlist on PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013179

Come say hello on our Discord: https://discord.gg/goldfire
